defs.def: to use more of sth than is necessary or useful 浪费；滥用

ex.s: Each dish was tailor-made to raise awareness regarding food waste.
ex.t: 两年后，即在怀俄明州建州之前的18年，黄石成为了美国乃至世界上第一个国家公园。

ex.s: Restaurants like Silo in the UK have experimented with zero-waste systems, but wastED took the concept to its logical conclusion.
ex.t: 像英国 Silo 这样的餐厅已尝试过零浪费系统，但 wastED 采取了更进一步的方式……

ex.s: Though wastED received enthusiastic reviews, it was designed from the start as a short-lived experiment; Blue Hill has since returned to its regular menu.
ex.t: 尽管wastED收获了热烈好评，它从一开始就被设计成短期实验；Blue Hill此后已恢复常规菜单。

ex.s: What can we learn about wastED?
ex.t: 关于wastED我们能了解到什么？

ex.s: Inside the office, they encourage recycling and waste reduction by limiting garbage cans and avoiding single-use plastic.
ex.t: 在办公室里，他们通过减少垃圾桶、避免使用一次性塑料来鼓励回收利用和减少浪费。

ex.s: Zero waste was a radical lifestyle movement a few years back.
ex.t: 零浪费在几年前还是一场激进的生活方式运动。

ex.s: A few days later, I came back with my first jars of zero waste groceries, and my dad commented on how silly it was for me to carry jars everywhere.
ex.t: 几天后，我带着第一批零浪费杂货罐回来，我爸爸评论说，我到处带着罐子真是傻。

ex.s: Yet as the months of reducing waste continued, I did what I could that was within my own reach.
ex.t: 然而随着减少浪费的日子一天天过去，我在力所能及的范围内尽我所能。

ex.s: How to live a zero waste lifestyle in a household.
ex.t: 如何在一个家庭里过零浪费的生活。

ex.s: Like most of us, I try to be mindful of food that goes to waste.
ex.t: 像大多数人一样，我尽量注意不要浪费食物。

ex.s: That makes food waste an environmental problem.
ex.t: 这使食物浪费成为一个环境问题。

ex.s: In fact, Royte writes, “if food waste were a country, it would be the third largest producer of greenhouse gases in the world.”
ex.t: 事实上，罗伊特写道："如果食物浪费是一个国家，它将是世界第三大温室气体排放国。"

ex.s: “Everyone can play a part in reducing waste, whether by not purchasing more food than necessary in your weekly shopping or by asking restaurants to not include the side dish you won’t eat,” Curtin says.
ex.t: “每个人都可以在减少浪费方面发挥作用，无论是在每周购物时不买超过需要的食物，还是要求餐厅不要上你不吃的配菜，”Curtin说。

ex.s: We pay little attention to food waste.
ex.t: 我们很少关注食物浪费。

ex.s: We waste food unintentionally at times.
ex.t: 我们有时无意中浪费食物。

ex.s: We waste more vegetables than meat.
ex.t: 我们浪费的蔬菜比肉类多。

ex.s: What is a consequence of food waste according to the test?
ex.t: 根据文章，食物浪费的一个后果是什么？

ex.s: More takeout and more food delivery equal more waste, especially plastic waste.
ex.t: 更多的外卖和更多的食品配送意味着更多的浪费，特别是塑料垃圾。

ex.s: The three-month, 1 900-mile journey from Paris to Warsaw is Dubanchet’s ___39___ of raising awareness of food waste in Europe and throughout the world.
ex.t: 杜邦谢从巴黎到华沙历时三个月、1900英里的旅程，是他___39___提高欧洲及全世界对食物浪费关注的方式。

ex.s: For legal ___44___, most restaurants have a policy against ___45___ food waste.
ex.t: 出于法律___44___，大多数餐厅有反对___45___食物浪费的规定。

ex.s: B．Waste one's energy taking risks．
ex.t: B．年龄不是实现目标的障碍

ex.s: He directed the wasted water into shallow basins where it froze, and was stored until the spring.
ex.t: 他将这些浪费的水引入浅水池中冻结储存，直到春天使用。

ex.s: Most of us are aware that we must take care of the environment, and the majority of us take steps to save energy and reduce waste and pollution.
ex.t: 我们大多数人都意识到必须爱护环境，并且我们中多数人都在采取措施节约能源、减少浪费和污染。

ex.s: In Save Money: Good Food, she visits a different home each week and with the help of chef Matt Tebbutt offers top tips on how to reduce food waste, while preparing recipes for under £5 per family a day.
ex.t: 在《省钱：美味食物》中，她每周走访一户不同的家庭，并在厨师马特·特巴特的帮助下，提供减少食物浪费的顶级建议，同时准备每天每户不到5英镑的食谱。

ex.s: It could be a waste of time.
ex.t: 这可能是浪费时间。

ex.s: Many supermarkets are no longer doing “buy one get one free” promotions because of the   60   (criticize) that they lead to waste.
ex.t: 许多超市不再做'买一送一'促销活动，因为有人____60____（批评）这会导致浪费。

ex.s: Norphel’s inspiration came from seeing the waste of water over winter, when it was not needed.
ex.t: 诺普尔的灵感来自于看到冬季水的浪费，那时水并不需要。

ex.s: Food waste is a growing concern in the restaurant, supermarket, and supply chain industries.
ex.t: 食物浪费正日益成为餐饮、超市和供应链行业关注的问题。

ex.s: In a world where nearly 800 million people a year go hungry, “food waste goes against the moral grain,” as Elizabeth Royte writes in this month’s cover story.
ex.t: 在一个每年近8亿人挨饿的世界里，"食物浪费违背道德准则，"伊丽莎白·罗伊特在本月封面故事中写道。

ex.s: You may not know over 30% of the world's food is wasted, while many people in poor areas do not have enough to eat.
ex.t: 你可能不知道，全世界超过30%的食物被浪费了，而贫困地区的许多人却没有足够的食物吃。

ex.s: Reducing daily food waste by just 5% could save millions of people from starvation.
ex.t: 仅将每日食物浪费减少5%，就能让数百万人免于饥饿。

ex.s: Producing food that no one eats wastes the water, fuel, and other resources used to grow it.
ex.t: 生产无人食用的食物，会浪费种植它所用的水、燃料和其他资源。

ex.s: I experienced this when I started switching to a zero waste lifestyle five years ago, as I was living with my parents, and I continue to experience this with my husband, as he is not completely zero waste like me.
ex.t: 五年前我刚开始转向零废弃生活方式时就有这种体会，那时我和父母同住；现在和丈夫在一起也继续有这种体会，因为他不像我那样完全零废弃。

ex.s: Nevertheless, this interview wasn’t a wasted opportunity.
ex.t: 尽管如此，这次面试并非浪费的机会。

ex.s: To make the public aware of food waste.
ex.t: 让公众意识到食物浪费问题。

ex.s: We have good reasons for wasting food.
ex.t: 我们有充分的理由浪费食物。

defs.def: to give, say, use, etc. sth good where it is not valued or used in the way that it should be 白费；糟蹋

ex.s: Another issue is that the human brain is highly sensitive to wasted effort.
ex.t: 营员享受的师生比根据年龄组从1:4到1:7不等。

defs.def: to not make good or full use of sb/sth 未充分利用；使 … 屈才
to get rid of sb, usually by killing them 干掉；把 … 废了；杀死

ex.s: Should you come across waste paper thrown out of a passing car, pick it up.
ex.t: 如果你看到从经过的汽车里扔出的废纸，请把它捡起来。

defs.def: to defeat sb very badly in a game or competition （游戏或比赛中）大胜，把 … 打得落花流水
the act of using sth in a careless or unnecessary way, causing it to be lost or destroyed 浪费；滥用
a situation in which it is not worth spending time, money, etc. on sth 白费；糟蹋
materials that are no longer needed and are thrown away 废料；废物；弃物；垃圾

ex.s: For two weeks in March, Greenwich Village’s Blue Hill restaurant was renamed wastED, and served items like fried skate cartilage, a juice pulp burger, and a dumpster diver’s vegetable salad.
ex.t: 三月的头两周，格林尼治村的蓝山餐厅改名为wastED，供应诸如炸鳐鱼软骨、果汁渣汉堡和垃圾箱潜水者蔬菜沙拉之类的菜品。

ex.s: UPCYCLING is a programme that intends to reduce waste.
ex.t: “升级再造”是一个旨在减少废弃物的项目。

ex.s: It should be noted that none of the items on wastED’s menu was technically made from garbage.
ex.t: 值得注意的是，wastED菜单上的所有菜品严格来说都不是用垃圾制作的。

ex.s: However, according to a report by the World Wildlife Fund, tourists ____18____ (leave) over 1.3 billion tons of food waste last year, ____19____ accounted for about 8% of the total global gas release in 2024.
ex.t: 然而，根据世界自然基金会的一份报告，游客去年___18___（留下）超过13亿吨食物垃圾，___19___约占2024年全球气体排放总量的8%。

ex.s: “We are passionate about reducing waste, carbon and chemicals in our environment,” said a BMF employee.
ex.t: 我们热衷于减少环境中的废弃物、碳排放和化学品，”一位BMF员工说。

ex.s: I held presentations at schools to teach kids about plastic waste.
ex.t: 我在学校做了演讲教孩子们关于塑料废物的知识。

ex.s: Just 9% of global plastic waste is recycled.
ex.t: 全球仅有9%的塑料废物被回收。

ex.s: Drawing public attention to plastic waste.
ex.t: 引起公众对塑料垃圾的关注。

ex.s: So what should cheese makers do with the waste?
ex.t: 那么奶酪制造商应该如何处理这些废料呢？

ex.t: 他们带着大量垃圾上山。

ex.t: 这很重要，因为这些不同类型的废物可以得到适当且有效的处理或回收。

ex.t: 他想，通过正确的动植物组合，也许他能像大自然那样清理废物。

ex.t: 为学生B的纠正做好准备生活垃圾的分类旨在帮助人们分离不同类型的垃圾。

not suitable for building or growing things on and therefore not used 荒芜的；废弃的

ex.s: I also offered to cook every so often, so I portioned out a bit of the cupboard for my own zero waste groceries.
ex.t: 我也主动提出偶尔做饭，所以我在橱柜里分出一点空间存放自己零废弃的杂货。
